A headline (<= 12 words) names what the point is about without giving it away; it is shown on the front of an ebmiss card next to the question. dimension is one of the 8 below; repoSpecific = the point is about this repo's own code, names or numbers. questions[i][j] is key point j of question i (the flat key-point index is the position in questions.flat()); kpHash = first 16 hex of sha256(key point text), so a re-seeded key point with new text no longer matches its headline.
